text: Simple illustration of imagine a moment of majestic triumph: a heavy-duty, industrial starship ascends through a sea of perfectly fluffy cumulus clouds. The ship itself is a titan of military engineering, constructed from weathered, rugged matte gray alloys. The design should convey massive power and function. The bright, clean sunlight hits the ship at a sharp angle, dramatically highlighting its angular plating and creating deep, powerful shadows on its underbelly. The sky is a vast, pure cerulean blue canvas. The overall mood is one of serene, unstoppable dominance, like a god descending from the heavens. Style: Ultra-realistic Sci-Fi Concept Art, like something from a modern AAA video game.
